mapper.update: UPDATE applications SET active = FALSE, data = JSON_SET(CAST(data AS JSON), '$.state', 'Inactive') WHERE id = #{applicationId}

UPDATE applications SET active = TRUE, data = JSON_SET(CAST(data AS JSON), '$.state', 'Active') WHERE id = #{applicationId}
UPDATE applications SET active = TRUE, data = JSONB_SET(data::JSONB, '{state}', '"Active"') WHERE id = #{applicationId}
mapper.select: WHERE a.forms_id = #{formId} ORDER BY a.name ASC, a.id, avk.type, avk.is_default DESC, avk.keys_id

WHERE a.tenants_id = #{tenantId}
ORDER BY a.name ASC, a.id, avk.type, avk.is_default DESC, avk.keys_id

WHERE a.active = true
AND (a.tenants_id = #{tenantId} or a.universal = true)
ORDER BY a.insert_instant DESC, a.id, avk.type, avk.is_default DESC, avk.keys_id

WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.active = true
AND (a.tenants_id = #{tenantId} OR a.universal = true)
ORDER BY a.id, avk.type, avk.is_default DESC, avk.keys_id

WHERE
a.id != #{id} AND
a.name = #{name}
AND (a.tenants_id = #{tenantId} OR a.universal = true)
